cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline assistant that answers Nigerian personal-income-tax questions — tax bands, reliefs, calculations, and what-if scenarios — in English and Nigerian Pidgin, with every trained answer verified by a deterministic tax rules engine.

test_prompts.prompt: I earn NGN 800,000 a year and no deductions or reliefs. How much tax do I pay? Please show the calculation.
What are the individual income-tax bands in Nigeria for the 2026 year of assessment?
